Midweek, a friendly note for new travelers
It concerns the desk
Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers should know that the desk is here to make pet plans feel simple and calm. Please read the notes below before you arrive with a companion animal, so the check-in steps go smoothly for everyone.

The senior coordinator reviews special cases, and the welcome team helps with boarding guidance. <<FACT F078>> If you are bringing a larger companion, <<FACT F057>> Please keep your travel papers ready and share any care needs early, because that helps the desk give clear support.

We are glad to answer questions in a warm, professional way and help you feel prepared. For the next step, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
